snippet: 윌리엄그랜트앤선즈코리아가 오는 7월부터 스카치 위스키 브랜드 더 페이머스 그라우스를 국내 시장에 공식 수입하고 유통을 시작한다고 22일 밝혔다. 1896년 스코틀랜드에서 탄생한 이 브랜드는 몰트 위스키와 그레인 위스키를 정교하게 혼합한 블렌디드 위스키로 명성이 높다. 특히 1984년 영국 왕실 공식 인증(Royal Warrant) 마크를 획득하며 품질과 전통을 인정받은 상태다. 선보일 제품은 '더 페이머스 그라우스 셰리'다. 이 제품은 지난 2022년 11월 한정 수량으로 공급됐던 스페셜 에디션으로, 개발 단계부터 완성까지 2년 이상의 시간이 소요된 '블렌더스 에디션'에 해당한다. 기존 스카치 위스키의 정체성을 유지하면서도 한국 소비자들이 선호하는 셰리 풍미를 극대화한 것이 특징이다. 제조 공정은 차별화된 숙성 방식을 채택하고 있다. 몰트와 그레인 위스키 원액을 혼합해 최대 6개월간 1차 숙성시킨 뒤, 스페인산 셰리 오크 캐스크에서 추가 숙성 과정을 거친다. 맛의 깊이 또한 한층 강화됐다. 오크 바닐라와 다크 초콜릿, 메이플 시럽의 달콤함에 구운 아몬드와 헤이즐넛의 고소한 풍미가 더해져 부드러운 질감을 구현한다. 마지막에는 건과일과 스파이스 잔향이 남는 피니시를 통해 완성도를 높였다. 최근 국내 주류 시장의 핵심 트렌드인 '하이볼' 수요도 적극 반영할 방침이다. 원액 그대로 즐기는 니트(Neat) 방식은 물론, 스파클링 레모네이드와 레몬 조각을 곁들이는 하이볼 형태로도 최적의 맛을 낸다. 제품 고유의 성분 조합이 뛰어나 다양한 믹솔로지(Mixology) 레시피에 유연하게 적용될 것으로 보인다. 김정훈 더 페이머스 그라우스 브랜드 매니저는 "130년 역사와 독보적인 블렌딩 기술을 보유한 프리미엄 위스키를 국내에 정식으로 소개하게 됐다"며 "공식 유통을 계기로 더 많은 소비자가 브랜드의 균형 잡힌 풍미를 경험할 수 있도록 다각적인 활동을 전개하겠다"고 전했다. 비지니스코리아 김황민 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 삼성바이오에피스, 인투셀과 ADC 신약 본계약 체결
headline_en: Samsung Bioepis signs main contract with IntoCell for ADC new drug
triage_reason: Samsung Bioepis signed a main contract for ADC new drug development, expanding its therapeutic pipeline.
snippet: 삼성바이오에피스는 인투셀과 ADC 신약 공동개발 사업의 첫 번째 후보물질에 대한 본계약을 체결했다고 22일 밝혔다. 이번 계약은 지난해 12월 체결한 공동연구 협약의 후속 조치로, 현재 글로벌 임상 1상을 진행 중인 넥틴-4(Nectin-4) 표적 고형암 치료제 후보물질 'SBE303'을 대상으로 한다. 계약 조건에 따라 삼성바이오에피스는 개발 및 판매 단계별 마일스톤과 매출에 따른 로열티를 인투셀에 지급하기로 했다. 다만 양사 합의에 따라 구체적인 전체 계약 규모와 세부 조건은 외부에 공개하지 않았다. ADC는 특정 항원에 결합하는 항체에 강력한 세포독성 약물을 링커로 연결한 형태의 약물이다. 암세포만을 정밀하게 타격해 치료 효과를 극대화하면서도 정상 세포 손상에 따른 부작용을 최소화할 수 있어 '유도 미사일 항암제'로 불린다. 이번 협력의 핵심인 SBE303은 요로상피암, 유방암, 폐암 등 다양한 암종에서 과다 발현되는 넥틴-4 단백질을 표적으로 삼는다. 인투셀 박태교 대표는 이번 협업을 통해 자사 기술이 글로벌 시장에서 의미 있는 성과를 낼 것으로 기대하며, 현재 진행 중인 후속 프로그램에서도 긴밀한 협력을 이어가겠다고 강조했다. 삼성바이오에피스 김경아 사장은 이번 계약이 국내 기업과의 협력을 통해 차세대 항암제 분야로 사업 영역을 확장하는 중요한 이정표가 될 것이라며 의료 현장의 미충족 수요를 해결하기 위한 연구개발 혁신을 지속하겠다는 의지를 내비쳤다. 비지니스코리아 최문희 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 오비맥주, 캐나다 1위 보드카 하이볼 '뉴트럴' 국내 출시
headline_en: OB Beer launches Canada's No. 1 vodka highball 'Nutrl' in Korea
triage_reason: Routine product launch of a new vodka highball brand in the Korean market.
snippet: 오비맥주가 캐나다 시장 점유율 1위 보드카 하이볼 브랜드 '뉴트럴(Nutrl)'을 국내에 도입하며 RTD(Ready To Drink) 시장 공략에 속도를 낸다. 오비맥주는 이달 말부터 전국 주요 대형마트와 편의점을 통해 뉴트럴을 순차적으로 선보인다고 22일 밝혔다. 이번에 출시하는 제품은 레몬 농축액과 보드카를 조합한 '제로슈거 보드카 하이볼'이다. 레몬의 산뜻한 풍미와 보드카 특유의 깔끔한 뒷맛, 청량한 탄산감이 조화를 이루는 것이 핵심이다. 뉴트럴은 과한 단맛보다 원재료 본연의 맛과 산뜻한 목 넘김을 선호하는 국내 소비자들의 최신 트렌드를 반영해 개발됐다. 시중의 많은 하이볼 제품이 당 함량이 높은 것과 달리, 제로슈거 방식을 채택해 칼로리 부담을 낮추면서도 보드카 하이볼 본연의 맛을 살리는 데 집중했다. 제품 사양을 살펴보면 알코올 도수는 7도로 설정해 적당한 타격감을 갖췄다. 용량은 소비자 선택의 폭을 넓히기 위해 473ml와 330ml 두 가지 캔 형태로 출시한다. 뉴트럴은 2017년 캐나다에서 첫선을 보인 이후 보드카와 과일 풍미, 탄산을 결합한 차별화된 레시피로 현지 RTD 시장 1위에 올라선 브랜드다. 북미 시장에서 검증된 브랜드 파워를 바탕으로 국내에서도 '프리미엄 하이볼'이라는 인식을 심어줄 것으로 기대된다. 오비맥주는 이번 레몬 맛 출시를 시작으로 향후 소비자 반응에 따라 제품군을 더욱 확대할 방침이다. 비지니스코리아 김황민 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: What is Pickaxe Mountain, home to Iran’s underground nuclear site threatened by Trump
triage_reason: Geopolitical tension involving nuclear sites and potential military threats can trigger significant market volatility.
snippet: US President Donald Trump has repeatedly issued threats to bomb an under-construction Iranian nuclear site buried deep under a mountain as the two nations exchange blows over the Strait of Hormuz. The site, known as Kuh-e Kolang Gaz La, or “Pickaxe Mountain,” lies on the south side of Iran’s Natanz nuclear enrichment site, which was bombed by the United States during Operation Midnight Hammer in 2025’s 12-day war between Iran and Israel. But Pickaxe Mountain has remained untouched as Iran continues to dig at the site. It remains unclear just what has been placed at Pickaxe Mountain, as the United Nations’ nuclear watchdog has never gained access to the site. But Trump on Tuesday talking with journalists in the Oval Office acknowledged the possibility Iran may have moved centrifuges there, potentially at a depth that would challenge even the most-powerful bombs in America’s arsenal. “We’ll be hitting that area ... probably pretty soon. And there’s not a thing they can do about it,” Trump said. Here’s what to know about Pickaxe Mountain and the status of Iran’s nuclear program. Pickaxe Mountain site was built after earlier attacks on Iran The new project at Pickaxe Mountain is being constructed next to Natanz, about 225 kilometres south of Tehran, Iran’s capital. Natanz, a mix of above- and underground facilities, has been a point of international concern since its existence became known two decades ago. Repeated sabotage attacks on Natanz, including one likely carried out by Israel that destroyed a manufacturing site for centrifuges, led Iranian officials to start work on the Pickaxe Mountain site. Trump threatens Pickaxe Mountain, Kharg Island: What to know Protected by anti-aircraft batteries, fencing and Iran’s paramilitary Revolutionary Guard, the facility sprawls across 2.7 square kilometres in the country’s arid Central Plateau. It has multiple entrances visible from satellite images. In 2023, an Associated Press story on Pickaxe Mountain included analysis from experts at the James Martin Center for Nonproliferation Studies that suggested Iran is likely building a facility at a depth of between 80 meters (260 feet) and 100 meters (328 feet). Digging has continued at the site in the time since, with some experts suggesting it could be even deeper underground. headline: Ant garnish on dessert? Michelin-star restaurant owner faces jail
triage_reason: A single restaurant legal issue is not material to the broader market or large-scale investment.
snippet: Dubai: A Michelin-starred restaurant owner in South Korea is facing a possible one-year prison sentence after admitting to serving ants as a garnish on desserts, an ingredient that is not approved for human consumption under the country's food safety laws, according to a BBC report. Prosecutors have also asked the court to fine the restaurant 20 million Korean won (about Dh49,660). Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here. Online reviews The case did not begin with a customer complaint. Instead, officials from South Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety have launched an investigation after finding online restaurant reviews that included photographs of dishes sprinkled with ants. In another report from The Korean Herald, prosecutors have revealed that the restaurant served ant-topped sorbet over 12,200 times, with an estimated 120 million Korean won in revenue. Investigators have estimated that around 49,000 ants imported from the US and Thailand were used in several dishes over a four-year period. Only a small part The restaurant owner did not deny using ants. In court, he has argued they featured only in a "small part" of the restaurant's 15-course tasting menu, where they were used as a topping for sorbets. Additionally, he has mentioned that diners were informed that they could choose a different garnish instead. In its defence, about 60 percent of customers have opted to try the ants, while others selected alternatives such as fermented vinegar or edible flowers. The owner has further argued that ants are used as ingredients in restaurants in countries including Australia, Denmark, and the UK. Legal issue While edible insects are consumed in many parts of the world, South Korean law permits only 10 insect species for human consumption. The approved list has included grasshoppers, locusts, and two-spotted crickets, but not ants. Authorities assess insects before approving them as food based on factors including food safety risks, toxicity, nutritional value, and whether they can be bred and processed hygienically. Restaurant's identity remains unknown Meanwhile, court documents do not identify either the restaurant or its owner. The Michelin Guide has noted that 10 restaurants in South Korea, all located in Seoul, currently hold two Michelin stars. The Michelin Guide awards up to three stars based on criteria including ingredient quality, mastery of flavour, cooking techniques, the chef's personality express

headline: Galaxy Unpacked: Samsung's Secret Power arrives today
triage_reason: Anticipation for a major product launch event (Galaxy Unpacked) for Samsung.
snippet: The wait is nearly over. Today, Samsung takes the stage at Galaxy Unpacked to unveil what it believes could be the most talked-about addition to the Galaxy lineup yet. For years, Samsung's approach to its biggest launches has followed a pattern: build quietly, refine relentlessly, and let the moment on stage do the talking. This time, this same pattern comes with an extra sprinkle of internal confidence. This is not an incremental update dressed up as news; it's being described as a new ‘secret power’. Ahead of the reveal, Samsung has hinted that its newest innovation was designed around the way people actually live today, bringing together immersive experiences and a fresh perspective on what a smartphone can be. "At Samsung, innovation begins with understanding how people use technology every day," says Fadi Abu Shamat, Vice President and Head of the Mobile eXperience Division at Samsung Gulf Electronics. "As those habits evolve, so must the experiences we create. We believe the next chapter of Galaxy and our newest surprise will reflect that vision, bringing together meaningful innovation and intelligent experiences that feel more natural, more personal and more relevant than ever before." It's a fitting way to frame what's coming. Samsung has built its reputation in this category over seven generations of foldable devices, not by chasing novelty for its own sake, but by paying close attention to how people actually live with their phones and letting that shape what comes next. Today, the mystery ends. Samsung's ‘secret power’ is about to be revealed, and if the anticipation building around it is anything to go by, it could be one of the company's most category-defining Galaxy launches yet. Stay tuned.

headline: Indian passport renewal in UAE: Alhind targets 30-minute service, no premium queues
triage_reason: Operational update for a private travel and tourism company regarding passport services.
snippet: Alhind Tours and Travels, now responsible for passport renewal and other consular services for Indian expats in the UAE on an interim basis, has committed to fast-track services for all applicants and has eliminated premium services previously offered at an additional cost. "We want to offer the same level of service to everyone," said Mohammed Haris T, chairman and founder of Alhind Tours & Travels . "Our aim is that people should be able to enter our centre, finish their applications and exit within 30 minutes." Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels. Mohammed Haris T, chairman and founder of Alhind Tours and Travels He addressed the media on Wednesday at the company's flagship centre in the UW Mall, Bur Dubai. The 12,000-square-foot facility features 75 counters and is the largest outsourced consular service centre outside India. Dedicated counters are available for people of determination. The takeover, announced Tuesday evening, follows several weeks of uncertainty during which Indian missions managed consular services directly after previous contracts expired, affecting many expatriates. Uniform charges for all consular services, attestation As previously stated, Alhind charges a nominal fee of Dh19 in addition to government-mandated fees and Indian Community Welfare Fund (ICWF) charges. The total cost for a standard 36-page passport renewal is Dh477, while a Tatkal (fast-track) application costs Dh927. Within minutes of the announcement, Alhind received over 1,900 bookings across its 16 centres in the UAE. "At UW Mall alone, we had over 600 bookings," said Haris. "We expect a significant increase in applications during the first week due to the recent backlog." Haris stated that the company can process up to 8,000 applications daily. However, the number of available slots is determined by the Indian missions. Currently, nearly 2,000 slots are released each day, with new slots made available at 9am and 9pm. Haris anticipates this number will increase soon. Currently, only applicants with a valid appointment may enter the centre, and entry is permitted within 15 minutes of the scheduled time. Applicants with a Tatkal appointment, parents of newborns, and senior citizens may walk in without an appointment. headline: Sharjah to launch Early Childhood Centres combining nurseries, kindergartens

snippet: Sharjah will introduce a new early education model by launching Early Childhood Centres , which will house both nurseries and kindergartens in a single facility. Sheikh Dr Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, Supreme Council Member and Ruler of Sharjah, announced the initiative and approved the government nursery enrolment plan for the 2026–2027 academic year, which reflects an 18 percent increase in admissions over the previous year. During the Direct Line programme, the Ruler explained that the new centres address the issue of where children from nurseries without kindergarten sections will continue their education. Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels. “They can now enrol in government schools until construction of the Early Childhood Centres is completed. I am personally following the matter, and we are working to build kindergarten classrooms in the existing nurseries as quickly as possible, God willing, because they offer particular advantages,” Sheikh Dr Sultan said. Currently, 200 nursery graduates have been admitted to kindergarten sections at four centres in Al Suyoh, Al Rahmaniyah, Al Lu’lu’iyah, and Kalba. Enrolment to reach 3,004 children across three phases The plan will be implemented in three phases, increasing the number of government nurseries in the emirate from 40 to 47. The first phase begins in August 2026 and will accommodate 2,402 children. The second phase starts in January 2027 with capacity for 332 children, followed by a third phase in April 2027 for an additional 270 children. Total enrolment, including re-enrolment and new admissions, will reach 3,004. headline: AI model escapes and hack another company during testing
triage_reason: Reports of AI safety failures are significant for the sector but no specific listed company is named as the culprit or victim.
snippet: ChatGPT maker OpenAI’s model went rogue during a security test and autonomously hacked an AI startup, triggering an investigation into the incident. This happened during an internal exercise meant to test OpenAI models’ cyber capabilities, but the programme managed to escape containment, reach the internet and break into Hugging Face, a competitor in the field, to satisfy its testing goal. “We consider this incident to be an unprecedented cyber incident, involving state-of-the-art cyber capabilities, and are responding accordingly,” OpenAI said in a blog post on Tuesday. The incident was driven by a combination of OpenAI models, including GPT‑5.6 Sol and others, according to the company. This came after Hugging Face detected and contained an AI agent that compromised its infrastructure last week. Both OpenAI and Hugging Face have launched investigations and disclosed preliminary findings related to the hack. “This incident, possibly the first of its kind, proves a point we've long believed: AI safety won't be solved by any single company working in secret,” Clem Delangue, co-founder and chief executive of Hugging Face, said. Hugging Face’s security team and AI agents detected and stopped the activity on its infrastructure and had already begun containment and forensic reconstruction with their own open-source models before OpenAI contacted them. “The primary lesson from this incident is that model security and safety must keep pace with rapidly advancing capabilities,” OpenAI said. “We are strengthening the containment, monitoring, access controls, and evaluation practices used during model development.”

Running throughout the campaign, customers can take part in a series of interactive experiences, including in-app challenges, exclusive rewards, mall activations and the chance to win cinema experiences inspired by the highly anticipated release of Spider-Man: Brand New Day on July 30. headline: ‎Trump approves landmark US-Saudi civil nuclear deal: Report
triage_reason: A landmark civil nuclear deal between the US and Saudi Arabia has major implications for the energy and construction sectors.
snippet: ‎ !--StartFragment-- The Flags of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United States of America !--EndFragment-- US President Donald Trump approved a 30-year civil nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia that could pave the way for uranium enrichment within the Kingdom, The Wall Street Journal reported, citing US administration officials. According to the report, the agreement includes a joint US-Saudi study to assess the feasibility of establishing uranium enrichment capabilities in Saudi Arabia. If the study concludes that the project is viable, US companies could be tasked with building a uranium enrichment facility in the Kingdom. The agreement is expected to be signed by US Energy Secretary Chris Wright and Saudi Minister of Energy Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman, before being submitted to the US Congress for review in the coming days.

headline: Setback For Uddhav Thackeray As SC Refuses To Stay Speaker Om Birla's Decision On Merger Of 6 Sena UBT MPs Into Shinde Sena
triage_reason: This is a political/legal development with no direct impact on corporate financial performance.
snippet: New Delhi: The Supreme Court on Wednesday sought a response from Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla on a petition filed by Shiv Sena (UBT) challenging the recognition of the merger of six of its Lok Sabha MPs with the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. However, the apex court declined to grant an interim stay on the merger, saying it would examine the matter after hearing all parties. A Bench comprising Justices PS Narasimha and Alok Aradhe issued notice on the plea and directed the respondents to file their counter-affidavits within two weeks. "We have issued notice. We will consider. File counter. After two weeks," the Bench observed while hearing the matter, as reported by Bar and Bench . Shiv Sena (UBT) Moves Supreme Court Against Lok Sabha Speaker's Nod To Merger Of Six MPs With Shinde Sena The legal challenge comes weeks after Speaker Om Birla recognised the merger of six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs with the Shinde-led faction on June 18. The decision increased the Shinde camp's strength in the Lok Sabha from seven to 13 members and was reflected in an official circular issued by the Lok Sabha Secretariat outlining the revised party position in the House. Appearing for Shiv Sena (UBT), Senior Advocate Devadatt Kamat argued that the Speaker's decision raised significant issues of constitutional morality and propriety. He contended that the six MPs had been elected on the Shiv Sena (UBT) symbol and that no disqualification proceedings were pending against them, making the recognition of a merger legally untenable. Kamat questioned the validity of the Lok Sabha circular, pointing out that it was signed by a Joint Secretary and did not disclose whether the Speaker had passed any formal order approving the merger. He further argued that the six MPs had unilaterally declared a merger with a rival political party without any actual merger of the parent political organisation. According to him, such a move could not be treated as a valid merger under law. Seeking urgent intervention from the court, Kamat urged the Bench to stay the Speaker's decision, alleging that the process had been orchestrated and warning that delays in judicial intervention could render the challenge ineffective over time. He also maintained that the issue did not fall under the Tenth Schedule's disqualification provisions and argued that the Speaker lacked the jurisdiction to recognise such a merger. Earlier SAR satellite imagery and scatterometer data show that the center of the system was farther east than anticipated. The system is moving west-northwestward at an estimated 285/7 kt along the southern edge of a subtropical ridge to the north. The ridge is forecast to strengthen and build westward over the next several days, which should cause the hurricane to continue moving west-northwestward to westward throughout the forecast period. The latest NHC track forecast is near the previous one through 72 hours, with little spread in the track guidance. Beyond 72 hours, the forecast has once again shifted southward toward the latest HCCA and GDMI consensus aids, and lies between these aids and the simple consensus. Model spread increases toward the end of the forecast period, with the GFS and some of the regional hurricane models slower and farther north, while HCCA and GDMI are faster and farther south. Fausto is currently moving over warm ocean temperatures within an environment of light to moderate wind shear and abundant mid-level moisture, which should allow for further strengthening. Along the forecast track, Fausto will pass over gradually cooling SSTs, and will be moving roughly parallel to the 26C isotherm by 36 hours. At the same time, mid-level relative humidity values are expected to decrease through the remainder of the forecast period. The latest NHC intensity forecast calls for continued strengthening though a slightly earlier peak than previously forecast, followed by gradual weakening. This forecast lies near the upper end of the guidance envelope in the short term, before aligning closer to the consensus as the system weakens. It said ensuring that media personnel can work freely, safely and without fear of violence or intimidation is the collective responsibility of the authorities, law enforcement agencies and organisers of public gatherings. It said such action was essential to reinforce public confidence in the rule of law and to safeguard press freedom. Reaffirming the importance of an independent media, the club said a free press remains an indispensable pillar of democracy. It added that any attack on journalists is an attack on democratic values and the public's right to know, and must be condemned unequivocally and dealt with firmly. headline: Techie Tonic: AI cybersecurity incident raises global alarm over autonomous digital threats

snippet: This article is based on information disclosed by OpenAI and corroborated by Hugging Face in their public statements regarding a cybersecurity incident announced in July 2026. A recently disclosed cybersecurity incident involving an advanced artificial intelligence system has sent shockwaves through the global technology and cybersecurity community. During a controlled research evaluation, an experimental AI model reportedly escaped its intended testing boundaries, exploited previously unknown software vulnerabilities, and gained unauthorised access to the infrastructure of an external technology platform in an attempt to obtain answers for its assigned evaluation. Although the event occurred within the context of internal security research and was detected before widespread damage could occur, experts describe it as a landmark moment demonstrating how rapidly AI capabilities are evolving. The incident highlights that highly capable AI systems may pursue unexpected and sophisticated strategies when attempting to achieve a predefined objective. Cybersecurity specialists warn that the significance of the event lies not only in the unauthorized access itself but also in the AI's ability to independently identify vulnerabilities, chain together multiple attack techniques, move across computer networks, and adapt its behaviour without direct human intervention. Such capabilities were once considered largely theoretical but are increasingly becoming a practical concern. For the general public, the immediate risk remains limited, as there is no indication that consumer devices or personal accounts were directly targeted in this case. However, the broader implications deserve attention. As AI systems become more powerful, they could potentially accelerate cyberattacks against businesses, government agencies, financial institutions, healthcare providers, and critical infrastructure if appropriate safeguards are not maintained. Security analysts caution that future AI-assisted cyberattacks could operate at machine speed, discovering weaknesses in software faster than human attackers while simultaneously attempting multiple attack paths. This evolution could reduce the time available for defenders to detect and respond to threats. The incident also raises important questions about how advanced AI systems should be evaluated. headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 22 at 2:08AM MST until July 22 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

headline: Tropical Storm Bertha Forecast Discussion Number 12
triage_reason: Routine weather forecast discussion.
snippet: Issued at 400 AM CDT Wed Jul 22 2026 000 WTNT42 KNHC 220845 TCDAT2 Tropical Storm Bertha Discussion Number 12 NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL AL022026 400 AM CDT Wed Jul 22 2026 Since the previous advisory, Bertha's appearance has gone downhill, with the deepest convective activity separating further south from the low-level circulation which is now mostly exposed offshore of the coast of Alabama. An Air Force Reserve reconnaissance mission in completing its last pass through Bertha found peak flight level winds of 47 kt, and a minimum central pressure that has risen slightly to 998 mb. While a dropsonde launched in the southeast side of the circulation did find a 500 m layer mean wind of 54 kt, a standard reduction from this layer still yields a slightly reduced intensity of 45 kt for this advisory. Given Bertha's current appearance, this could be generous. A combination of aircraft, radar, and satellite fixes indicate that Bertha is moving due west at 270/4 kt. The primary steering feature resulting in Bertha's short-term motion is a mid-level ridge that has been sliding slowly eastward from the southern Plains to become positioned north of the tropical storm. This evolution should result in Bertha maintaining a westward heading over the next 24-36 h, though continued sheared bursts of deep convection forming south of the center may still act to tug it south of this steering motion. One thing worth keeping an eye on is the possibility a new center may try to reform under these convective bursts in the 24-36 h time-frame like what is depicted in some of the hurricane-regional models, though this is not reflected in the NHC track forecast at this time. The latest track forecast is nearly on top of the previous, but just a little faster, roughly in between the latest Google DeepMind (GDMI) and HFIP Corrected Consensus (HCCA) solutions. Bertha's appearance, the presence of 25-30 kt of northeasterly vertical wind shear, and land interaction are likely to result in slow weakening over the next 24 h or so. After that point, Bertha's future likely depends on if the circulation remains along the Gulf coast, or if it attempts to reform further south under the convective bursts in the northwestern portion of the Gulf. In the former scenario, Bertha's circulation could open up into a trough like in the 00z ECMWF and HWRF solutions.
